title: Heterogeneous treatment effects by firm size in DID
research_question: Did a corporate tax cut (period 4) differentially affect investment for large vs. small firms, and can we identify heterogeneous treatment effects within a DID framework?
data_description: Panel data on 200 firms (100 large, 100 small) over 8 annual periods. Variables: unit_id, period, treated (1=large firm, subject to larger tax cut), post, treat_x_post, y (log investment), size_group (large/small). Both groups experience tax cuts but large firms benefit more.
